name: Bison Woodworks
old_description: We are a Family owned and operated custom woodworking company that specializes in custom cabinetry, interior doors, and other fine woodworking products.
about:
Bison Woodworks, a family-owned custom woodworking shop, operates from Eureka, Montana. The company was established in January 2017 as Eash & Miller Woodworks by Eli Eash, a former commercial logger turned custom home builder, and his brother-in-law Ryan Miller. After more than a decade in finish carpentry, Eash recognized a shortage of local cabinet makers amid a growing custom home market and launched the venture with Miller.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, interior doors, and other fine woodworking products for residential projects. While specific equipment and facility details are not disclosed, the operation emphasizes finish carpentry and custom millwork tailored to individual home designs.

Primary customers include custom home builders and homeowners in the Eureka region seeking bespoke cabinetry and door solutions. The company's founding was driven by demand from the local custom home market.

The founders cite a commitment to a high standard of quality and problem-solving as their guiding principle, with Ryan Miller having upheld that standard for seven years before departing in mid-2024, when the business adopted the Bison Woodworks name.
